Users can search for customer reviews by name and phone before taking jobs, and they can leave detailed reviews after completing projects. The platform also allows contractors to earn rewards through posting helpful reviews and referring others, making it easier to avoid bad leads and support the industry. Pricing starts at $5 per customer search, which helps contractors save time and resources while sharing valuable insights.
candidates.rationale: ReviewedByPros offers customer reputation checks for contractors, not scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, payments, or broader field-service management.

candidates.name: pro4me
candidates.description: pro4me is a platform that connects users with verified professionals for home maintenance and improvement jobs in South Africa. Users can browse available job postings, request quotes, and choose from various vetted professionals based on their specific needs and budget. The service offers secure payment options and ensures satisfaction through a straightforward process that includes project description, review, and approval before payments are made. Pro4me also provides resources for both individuals and businesses looking to connect with qualified professionals for various home maintenance services.
candidates.rationale: pro4me is a homeowner-to-service-professional marketplace, not field-service management software for trades businesses managing operations.

candidates.name: Service Biz Advisor
candidates.description: Service Biz Advisor is a service that connects local home service contractors with potential customers seeking home services without the need for traditional advertising. It delivers live, exclusive phone calls from clients who want quotes and estimates, allowing businesses to avoid high fees associated with traditional online reviews or Angie's Listing. The platform also offers text alerts and call backs when service providers are unavailable, enabling users to receive timely responses and manage their business operations more efficiently.
candidates.rationale: Service Biz Advisor provides lead generation for contractors, not field-service management software for scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, and payments.

candidates.name: MyWorkly
candidates.description: MyWorkly is a home service management platform designed to streamline operations for service businesses in industries like plumbing, HVAC, cleaning, and landscaping. It offers tools for scheduling jobs, managing customer communication, tracking employee hours, and processing payments all in one place. Key features include automated job notifications, real-time monitoring of staff activities, CRM integration with other business tools, and the ability to manage multiple teams efficiently. The platform aims to enhance productivity and improve customer experience while simplifying the hiring process for service professionals.
candidates.rationale: Both provide field-service management software for home-service businesses, including scheduling, workforce coordination, customer communication, and payments.

candidates.name: WLD Digital
candidates.description: WLD Digital offers website design and software solutions specifically designed for home service businesses, such as plumbing and landscaping. Their main product, BlueHammer, consolidates various business tasks like lead management, reminders, and scheduling into a single dashboard. They provide two options: a Website in a Day for quick setup, a Custom Website for custom needs, and local SEO services to improve online visibility on search engines. WLD Digital also offers ongoing support and updates to ensure the software runs smoothly.
candidates.rationale: WLD Digital primarily provides websites and SEO; its limited scheduling dashboard does not clearly replace Jobber’s field-service operations, dispatch, invoicing, and payments platform.

The platform allows businesses to create searchable listings quickly and offers features like job postings, event information, and coupons for deals. Members can register an account, connect with clients, and access resources to enhance their business presence.
candidates.rationale: AskOurPros is a professional-services directory and lead-discovery marketplace, not field-service operations software for scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, and payments.
